The 1 oz Gold Bar from the Sunshine Mint is a must-have for any precious metal investor or collector. Made of 999.9 fine gold, this bar is one of the purest on the market, making it an excellent choice for those looking to add value to their portfolio or collection. The bar’s design is simple yet elegant, featuring the iconic eagle of the Sunshine Mint on the front, along with the weight and purity inscribed above. The back of the bar has the “S” mintmark, signifying its authenticity as a product of the Sunshine Mint.
One of the unique features of this gold bar is the Tamper Evident Packaging (TEP) that it comes in. TEP packaging is an added security measure ensuring the bar remains in its original condition. The packaging is designed to show any tampering, making it difficult to open the packaging without leaving evidence of tampering, providing added security during transportation.

The 1 oz Gold Bar – Sunshine New Design (In TEP Packaging) from the Sunshine Mint is a unique and intricate gold bar that will impress. The front of the bar features a new and updated version of the iconic eagle design of the Sunshine Mint, a symbol of strength and freedom. The eagle is depicted in a highly detailed and intricate manner, with its wings spread out and its talons gripping a branch. Above the eagle, the weight and purity of the bar are inscribed, “1 oz .9999 FINE GOLD”.
The back of the bar features the “S” mintmark of the Sunshine Mint, a symbol of authenticity and quality. The mintmark is prominently displayed, ensuring that the bar is easily identifiable as a product of the Sunshine Mint. The bar’s background is a subtle, matte finish, contrasting with the highly detailed eagle on the front.
The overall design of the bar is modern and sleek, making it a great addition to any collection. The new and updated eagle design adds a unique touch to the bar, making it a timeless piece that will be appreciated by investors and collectors alike.
The bar also comes encased in Tamper Evident Packaging (TEP), providing an added security and protection layer. The TEP packaging is designed to show any tampering, ensuring that the bar remains in its original condition, making it a secure and valuable investment. The TEP packaging also features the iconic eagle design and the “S” mintmark, making it a perfect match to the bar inside.
